images.note: Real, unaltered Microsoft diagram showing the three Purview solution pillars (data security, data governance, data compliance) with their one-line mission statements. This is the single most directly relevant visual for a 'what is Purview' overview lesson — it's an overview/orientation lesson about the product family's shape, not a walkthrough of one UI screen, so one diagram (not the usual 3-screenshot floor) is the honest choice here; padding with unrelated portal screenshots (covered properly in Lesson 2) would be worse than this single targeted image. note: Course-opening conceptual lesson establishing what Microsoft Purview is, its three pillars, the Data Map vs. Unified Catalog distinction inside the governance pillar, and this course's 7-chapter roadmap. Pillar names, service names (Data Map, Unified Catalog), and the solution-area breakdown are drawn directly from Microsoft's live /purview and /purview-portal documentation pages (fetched 2026-10-05), not assumed from prior knowledge, since Purview's portal and naming have changed materially in 2025-2026 (unified purview.microsoft.com portal, Unified Catalog).
